sourcePolicy: Three genuine Traditional Chinese Android 1.0.16 (19) captures from the existing test APK, obtained with official adb in a fresh isolated API 35 emulator using the previously authorized method. Visible language setting 繁體中文 selected. No app source edits or rebuild. Four compositions; reward and candidate images reuse the actual candidate board. Only Android OS bars cropped, full app UI uniformly scaled; captions outside UI, no redrawing or AI bitmap assets.
